reproduction_sources.install-check.py:
import os, pathlib, subprocess, tempfile, json, tarfile, hashlib
base=pathlib.Path('/tmp/codex-tool-runs/svton/m2-closure-20260930')
source=pathlib.Path('/Users/zhaoxingbo/Workspace/ai-driven/svton/shipkit/bootstrap/install.sh').read_text()
results=[]
for mode in ['health-mismatch','restart-failure','preserve-role','chmod-failure','workroot-file']:
    d=pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='install-'+mode+'-',dir=base))
    for n in ['opt/shipkit/agent','etc/shipkit','etc/systemd/system','tmp','bin','payload/agent']:
        (d/n).mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    (d/'opt/shipkit/agent/server.js').write_text('OLD_AGENT')
    envfile=d/'etc/shipkit/agent.env';unit=d/'etc/systemd/system/ship-agent.service'
    oldenv='SHIP_AGENT_TOKEN=FAKE_OLD_TOKEN\nSHIP_PUSH_USER=olduser\nSHIP_PUSH_PASSWORD=FAKE_OLD_PASS\n'
    oldunit='Environment=SHIP_AGENT_ROLE=runtime\nEnvironment=SHIP_AGENT_PORT=17410\nEnvironment=SHIP_AGENT_HOST=127.0.0.1\nEnvironment=SHIP_WORK_ROOT='+str(d/'old-work')+'\n'
    envfile.write_text(oldenv);unit.write_text(oldunit)
    if mode=='workroot-file': (d/'new-work').write_text('existing ordinary file')
    (d/'payload/agent/server.js').write_text('NEW_AGENT');(d/'payload/VERSION').write_text('0.4.0')
    bundle=d/'input.tgz'
    with tarfile.open(bundle,'w:gz') as t:
        t.add(d/'payload/agent',arcname='agent');t.add(d/'payload/VERSION',arcname='VERSION')
    def shim(name,text):
        p=d/'bin'/name;p.write_text(text);p.chmod(0o755)
    shim('id','#!/bin/sh\necho 0\n')
    shim('apt-get','#!/bin/sh\nexit 93\n')
    shim('sleep','#!/bin/sh\nexit 0\n')
    shim('curl','#!/bin/sh\necho \'{"version":"'+('0.4.0' if mode=='preserve-role' else '0.3.0')+'"}\'\n')
    if mode=='chmod-failure': shim('chmod','#!/bin/sh\nexit 9\n')
    shim('systemctl','#!/bin/sh\n'+('if [ "$1" = restart ]; then exit 7; fi\n' if mode=='restart-failure' else '')+'exit 0\n')
    # Checksum command is a fixture here: this test concerns upgrade transaction semantics.
    # use actual sha256sum
    adapted=source.replace('/tmp/',str(d/'tmp')+'/').replace('/opt/shipkit',str(d/'opt/shipkit')).replace('/etc/shipkit',str(d/'etc/shipkit')).replace('/etc/systemd/system',str(d/'etc/systemd/system'))
    script=d/'install.sh';script.write_text(adapted)
    env={**os.environ,'PATH':str(d/'bin')+':'+os.environ['PATH'],'SKIP_DOCKER':'1','SKIP_SYSTEMD':'0','TARBALL':str(bundle),'TARBALL_SHA256':hashlib.sha256(bundle.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
    for k in ['ROLE','AGENT_TOKEN','AGENT_PORT','AGENT_BIND','WORK_ROOT','SHIP_PUSH_USER','SHIP_PUSH_PASSWORD','SHIP_PULL_USER','SHIP_PULL_PASSWORD']:
        env.pop(k,None)
    if mode!='preserve-role':
        env.update(ROLE='builder',AGENT_TOKEN='FAKE_NEW_TOKEN',AGENT_PORT='17411',WORK_ROOT=str(d/'new-work'))
    r=subprocess.run(['bash',str(script)],env=env,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=15)
    (base/('install-'+mode+'.log')).write_text(r.stdout+r.stderr)
    live=(d/'opt/shipkit/agent/server.js')
    results.append({'id':mode,'exit':r.returncode,'agent':live.read_text() if live.exists() else None,'secretsRestored':envfile.read_text()==oldenv,'unitRestored':unit.read_text()==oldunit,'currentRole':next((x.split('=',2)[2] for x in unit.read_text().splitlines() if x.startswith('Environment=SHIP_AGENT_ROLE=')),None),'oldTreeRemains':(d/'opt/shipkit.old').exists()})
(base/'install-results.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,indent=2))
print(json.dumps(results))
